definitions.explanation: A social gathering of former classmates or schoolmates, typically organized years after graduation to reconnect.
A formal organization of graduates from a particular school that maintains connections among alumni.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧、{同窓会|どうそうかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a class reunion next month.

examples.japanese: {二十年|にじゅうねん}⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{同窓会|どうそうかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{懐|なつ}かしい→懐かしい：02484_natsukashii⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{再会|さいかい}→再会：11667_saikai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was reunited with familiar faces at the reunion after twenty years.

examples.japanese: {同窓会|どうそうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}したら→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧ずいぶん⟦{変|か}わっていて→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: When I attended the class reunion, I was surprised at how much everyone had changed.

examples.japanese: {同窓会|どうそうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名簿|めいぼ}→名簿：11870_meibo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}する→更新する：27994_koushinsuru⟧。
examples.english: To update the alumni association directory.

examples.japanese: {同窓会|どうそうかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{奨学金|しょうがくきん}→奨学金：03230_shougakukin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設立|せつりつ}した→設立する：17473_setsuritsusuru⟧。
examples.english: The alumni association established a scholarship.

examples.japanese: {同窓会|どうそうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会長|かいちょう}→会長：11610_kaichou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I was elected president of the alumni association.

notes:
{同窓会|どうそうかい} refers to both informal class reunion gatherings and formal alumni associations. A very common word in Japanese social life.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{同窓|どうそう}→同窓：21161_dousou⟧ (same school — literally "same window," where ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧ represents the classroom) + ⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (meeting, association).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同窓会|どうそうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧ (to attend a reunion)
- {同窓会|どうそうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ (to hold a reunion)
- {同窓会|どうそうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{幹事|かんじ}→幹事：16378_kanji⟧ (reunion organizer)
- {同窓会|どうそうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{案内|あんない}→案内：01291_annai⟧ (reunion invitation)
- {同窓会|どうそうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名簿|めいぼ}→名簿：11870_meibo⟧ (alumni directory)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Class reunions are an important part of Japanese social culture. They are typically organized around milestone years after graduation (5, 10, 20 years). The ⟦{幹事|かんじ}→幹事：16378_kanji⟧ (organizer) role is often rotated among classmates.

- ⟦{同級生|どうきゅうせい}→同級生：03032_doukyuusei⟧: classmate (same grade)
- ⟦{卒業生|そつぎょうせい}→卒業生：15284_sotsugyousei⟧: graduate, alumnus
